Dialogue_Text: Ink Gallery: The List of Exhibits
Source_Context: InkGallery.tp2:692 SAY NAME1; InkGallery.tp2:693 SAY NAME2

Dialogue_Text:
The list includes all books that are currently presented to people. These are:

– Tale of the Eight-Legged Strider: a story about a group wading through the Demonweb Pits, trying to leave the domain of the Spider Queen.

– The Birth of the Fury: a tale from far Kara-Tur, about Chin Yi, as well as a swordsman from Shou Lung, and their love.

– The Deathly Groans: this novella presents a dreadful tale of a necromancer and an army of undead xvarts he decided to raise from their slumber.

– The War Below: this tale tells the story of one of the lesser-known adventures of the Heroes of Icewind Dale and how, during their attempt to stop a war between strange beings, they discovered a cave, home to a huge and quite dangerous creature.

– The Grasp of the Glabrezu: this cautionary tale describes a fight between a glabrezu, protected by bow-wielding devilesses, and a group of adventurers that were sent to Avernus to find and kill that glabrezu.

– The Dance of the Swords: the book describes a ball organized by a mysterious Maestro, and an unusual dance of literal swords, controlled by the bard.

– Of Seed & Fire: a story about an angry fire giant druid, who claimed a significant part of the bog and attacks those that dare to enter it.

– The Story of the Moon Sisters: a tale about three celestial sisters, the judges that live in a strange moon-like place, covered with silver sands.

– Tale of the Dead Eye: a novel in which a lone traveler has to travel through a strange place, a dead magic zone, and encounters a zombie beholder, hungry and angered, ready to attack.

– The Three Thirsty Rascals: a somewhat experimental story, a macabre comedy about three kobold vampires that terrorize a nearby village.

– The Waves of Flesheaters: a book that describes the struggle of a lone survivor walking down an old sewer system, where he has to face dozens of flesh-eating maggots hiding in the murky water and shadows.

– The Light in the Snow: a story of an old remorhaz roaming the far north, accompanied by creatures that seem like sentient winds.

All interested in learning more from these tales are welcome to visit the Ink Gallery and check the books with their own eyes.

Dialogue_Text:
This pamphlet shows some drawings of the Ink Gallery located in Athkatla, in the Government District. It also includes some testimonials left by other customers: 

"Some of those stories are truly marvelous! While they are a great opportunity to learn, remember to prepare yourself first!"
- Brienda Falcontrade, Shield-Bearer from Neverwinter

"The Ink Gallery taught me that literature may come with many thrills and excitements! Thank you for that!"
- Al'Mand Silloan, Priest of Helm from Calimport

"I never liked books and now—I think they're great!"
- John Bubblovich, a fashion figure from... somewhere!
